Gold Price Crash 2026: Gold prices in India have fallen nearly 29% from their January record, with Delhi gold rates dropping by a massive ₹53,700 per 10 grams to ₹1,29,300 on November 20. Will gold prices fall further? Is this the right time to buy gold, or should Indian buyers wait?
In today's Kharcha Pani, we examine the historic gold price crash, PM Narendra Modi's remarks on gold purchases, and the global economic forces driving the decline.
